text: Each class is written as (s, c): s is the length of the word (the Adams filtration), c is the colour (the number of letters μ). The colours up to n=150 are the Q-weight of Ext, checked cell by cell against a direct computation of the metalibrary (method). “Left” means after the rapacious rule (colour +1, “low”). The column “family” gives the class standing in the place of a Toda element (n=4k+2) or of a sandwich (n=4m+1). The colours of these classes run 3 4 4 5 5 6 …, as stated in the lecture.
The picture goes up to n=100; the table below, up to n=150.
